# WillSun Agency (Full Documentation)

> WillSun Agency is a premier global growth and commercialization studio founded by Will Sun, accelerating cross-border SaaS, global e-commerce, and industrial exporters with 17+ years of battle-tested mastery in SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and monetization architecture.

## Overview
- Website: https://willsun.agency
- Founder: Will Sun
- Track Record: 17+ years cross-border experience (10 years traffic generation + 7 years commercial monetization), over $10M in ad spend managed.
- Specializations:
  1. Cross-Border SaaS MRR Monetization & Unit Economics
  2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search Citation
  3. Technical SEO & High-Intent Search Funnels
  4. Precision Performance Ads (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok)
  5. AI Creative Generation (Visual Assets, Motion, Video)
  6. Vibe Coding Rapid Engineering (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailored Web Tools)

## Detailed Capabilities & Offerings

### 1. Cross-Border SaaS & E-Commerce Monetization
- **Pricing & Packaging Strategy**: Redesigning tiered pricing models, feature gates, and recurring subscription flows to maximize Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) and Annual Contract Value (ACV).
- **Unit Economics Optimization**: Analyzing and refining CAC, LTV, churn, payback periods, and gross margins to ensure sustainable scalability.
- **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**: Eliminating checkout friction, optimizing high-intent landing page copy, and building high-trust credibility signals.

### 2. Global SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
- **Entity Graph Building**: Structuring brand schema, knowledge graph connections, and semantically rich content for AI LLMs (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google SGE/AI Overviews).
- **High-Intent Search Targeting**: Capturing bottom-of-the-funnel buyer intent queries with programmatic SEO architectures and topical authority hubs.
- **Global Link Acquisition**: Establishing authentic, high-relevance editorial backlinks across global tech and industry publications.

### 3. AI-Powered Precision Performance Advertising
- **High-Frequency Creative Iteration**: Deploying proprietary AI workflows to generate dozens of conversion-tested image and video creatives per week.
- **Multi-Channel Orchestration**: Scaling cross-platform ad campaigns across Google Search/Performance Max, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and TikTok.
- **Strict ROAS & CAC Discipline**: Implementing server-side Conversions API (CAPI) and advanced attribution modeling to eliminate wasted ad spend.

### 4. AI Visual Design & Video Production
- **AI-Enhanced Motion & Video Ads**: High-retention short-form and product showcase video assets generated through state-of-the-art video AI tools.
- **3D & Product Visuals**: Photorealistic product staging, cinematic UI renderings, and brand asset generation.

### 5. Vibe Coding Rapid Tool & Web Development
- **Next.js & React Engineering**: Lightning-fast, mobile-first, zero-layout-shift web applications.
- **Interactive Calculators & Growth Widgets**: High-converting lead magnets and utility tools embedded into landing pages.

1. **Growth Sprint ($2,499 / Sprint)**

2. **Scale & Monetize ($4,999 / Month)**
   - Inclusions: Ongoing technical SEO & GEO citation management, full ad funnel optimization, continuous A/B testing, monthly high-converting AI creative packages, dedicated growth strategist.

3. **Enterprise Custom Partnership (Custom Pricing)**
   - Inclusions: Embedded chief growth strategist, bespoke engineering & tool building, localized expansion across Tier-1 global markets.
